title: Vercel recently shipped
description: A two-column bento of new products under a big tight heading: one tall card on the left and two 280px cards stacked on the right, all hairline-bordered with 6px corners on the page colour. Each card has a 24px title and a short grey line at its bottom-left, with artwork either tucked into the bottom-right corner or filling the right side and fading out towards the text. Borders darken slightly on hover. Phones stack the cards.
notes: the first card is the tall one on desktop; up to three cards
media per card: corner (a small square, a blue wash when empty) or side (right side, a grey panel fading left when empty)
the hover border change is inferred from the original's CSS, not seen in a capture
